# Table classes

Sources: `migrations/shard` (COMMENT ON TABLE 'class: <tag>'); register N113, N124, N137.

Every table of the shard schema carries one class tag. The DDL holds the one list and the move, the expunge and
`engramlint sql` read it; this document renders it. 56 tables.

## insert-only (22)

Write-once rows, no UPDATE path; only the expunge deletes (N113); each has ins_seq (N137).

- `chunk_vectors`, `chunks`, `consolidation_applied`, `consolidation_proposals`, `curation_log`, `deletion_log`,
  `document_version_chunks`, `entity_mentions`, `fact_consolidation`, `fact_links`, `fact_vectors`, `facts`,
  `ingest_ledger`, `observation_inputs`, `observation_version_meta`, `observation_version_sources`,
  `observation_version_vectors`, `observation_versions`, `page_version_inputs`, `page_version_meta`,
  `page_version_vectors`, `page_versions`

## mutable (24)

Narrow mutable state in fillfactor 50 to 70 tables that stay HOT (N113, N137).

- `batch_jobs`, `blob_tombstones`, `chunk_tombstones`, `consolidation_batches`, `consolidation_state`, `derived_hidden`,
  `document_tombstones`, `document_versions`, `documents`, `entities`, `entity_aliases`, `export_snapshots`,
  `expunge_progress`, `fact_hidden`, `idempotency_keys`, `namespace_models`, `observation_sources`, `observations`,
  `operations`, `page_sources`, `pages`, `quota_counters`, `tag_counts`, `token_usage`

## expiring (3)

Expiring or derived state, maintained by sweepers rather than written on the commit path (N137).

- `namespace_stats`, `token_usage_events`, `vector_indexes`

## shard-local (7)

State machine or log of the shard itself: the shard-level tables of section 3.3.1 (N124).

- `engram_seq_log`, `namespace_ownership`, `outbox`, `outbox_cursors`, `outbox_skipped`, `ownership_transitions`,
  `shard_meta`
